exposure: hereditary angioedema due to C1 inhibitor deficiency (C1INH-HAE)
outcome: Changes in symptoms during pregnancy and delivery
cohort: 61 C1 inhibitor deficiency hereditary angioedema (C1INH-HAE) patients from 5 hospitals specialized in the management of HAE in Spain
finding: Pregnancy has a variable influence on the clinical expression of C1INH-HAE, with attacks tending to occur more frequently but not to increase in severity, and vaginal delivery being mostly well tolerated.
mod_finding: Prophylactic pdhC1INH should be administered prior to cesarean delivery and is also recommended before vaginal delivery if there are additional risk factors.
